lantern.canon: old brass hurricane lantern, glass panes, bail handle, ~30 cm tall, small warm flame INSIDE the glass only
lantern.rules: never a torch; flame stays inside the glass; one lantern only

energy_blade.canon: straight rigid blade of bright blue energy from her open RIGHT palm, ~1 m long, glowing cyan
energy_blade.rules: always perfectly straight, no sword hilt, appears only B06-C09/C08-C09 shots

ash_wraiths.canon: tall faceless humanoids of dark grey ash, ember-orange eyes, edges dissolving
ash_wraiths.rules: die by dissolving into fine drifting ash that vanishes; no explosions, blobs or fireballs

maker.canon: old man, dark-brown wool robe, grey hair
maker.rules: seen from behind only, never his face; only in tower A shots

astra_state.canon: S0 clean -> S1 ash dust (B) -> S2 + cracked right shoulder plate (C) -> S3 dim LEDs/marks (D01-D06) -> S4 LEDs/marks dark (D07-D09), marks relight in D10

brazier_ring.canon: wide brass brazier on a stone dais at the foot of a 30 m stone sun-ring on the cliff top
brazier_ring.rules: same ring and brazier in every D shot; ring ignites in D08

bridge.canon: narrow ancient stone bridge, broken balustrades over a chasm
bridge.rules: collapses in C03 (stones fall); wraiths and Astra on it in C shots
